newsitem.title: CHINA: WEIGHTLIFTING-CHINA SETS SEVENTH WORLD RECORD.
newsitem.headline: WEIGHTLIFTING-CHINA SETS SEVENTH WORLD RECORD.

text.p: China has taken its tally of world records at the Asian weightlifting championships to seven with a 214-kg lift by Zhang Yong in the clean and jerk in the men's 83-kg division, the Xinhua news agency said.

Zhang, from China's western province of Sichuan, on Saturday bettered by half a kg the previous world mark set by German Huster Marc at the Atlanta Olympics last year, the news agency said in an overnight report.
"It's the first world record that a Chinese lifter has set in middle-weight classes for 40 years," it quoted Chinese men's coach Yang Hanxiong as saying.

Zhang, 24, also won a silver medal at the championships at Yangzhou in southeast China with a snatch of 165 kg and another gold medal by totalling 377.5 kg, breaking the previous Asian total record of 365 kg set by Niou Viatcheslav of Kazakhstan, the news agency said.

China's Yang Xia had earlier set two world marks by snatching 93.5 kg for a total 207.5 kg in the women's 54-kg division while Liu Xiuhua set a clean and jerk world best for the women's 54-kg class with a lift of 115.5 kg.
